assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with sick sinus syndrome, requiring continuous rhythm monitoring to evaluate for bradyarrhythmias or pauses.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction.
This is a mobile cardiac telemetry study with CPT 93229.
The service is indicated to assess for potential cardioembolic sources such as paroxysmal atrial fibrillation that may contribute to cerebrovascular risk.
The payer denied the claim based on CO-197.
The denial was based on CO-197 indicating that the required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
The clinical documentation establishes the medical necessity of the service at the time it was rendered.
